ledger.what: remove cookie/consent chrome (OneTrust, Cookiebot, Usercentrics, generic cookie-banner ids/classes)
ledger.why: overlay chrome injected by a CMP, not page content; re-added at deploy time

ledger.what: de-carousel slick/swiper/splide/glide: remove clone slides, force real slides visible+static, drop dots/arrows
ledger.why: hidden slides are absent from innerText and clones duplicate it — rotating carousels break byte determinism; the reskin renders all slides statically in DOM order

ledger.what: expand NSW accordions: remove hidden="until-found" from .nsw-accordion__content, set aria-expanded=true
ledger.why: collapsed panels are absent from innerText — same class as N-D2 hidden slides; the reskin renders every panel body (Figma Accordion expanded variant 12362:10348)

ledger.what: remove Material Icons ligature spans (.material-icons: keyboard_arrow_down, east, north)
ledger.why: aria-hidden decorative glyphs whose ligature names leak into innerText; donor supplies its own chevron/arrow glyphs via CSS (mapping-brief § Icon-ligature text, "normalize it away")

visibleTextNormalized: The Fortians Union The Fortian alumni associations began in 1894 to: 1. Build a Strong Community: Create a place where members can connect, have fun, and support each other. 2. Give Back to Fort Street: Actively contribute to the success of Fort Street High School through volunteer work, mentorship, or other initiatives. 3. Celebrate Our Legacy: Honour the rich history and traditions of Fort Street while embracing innovation and progress. For enquiries or to get in touch with the Fortians Union, please contact us via email at: fortians@fortians.au (opens in new window) Faber Est The Fortians Union publishes Faber Est, a regular newsletter. You can explore the latest edition and our growing archive by following this link: Faber Est (opens in new window) . Membership Membership of the Fortians Union is free for the first five years after leaving school. Life membership is available for a one off fee of $50.00. To join, complete the online form by clicking here. Join our Fortians Union Facebook Group (opens in new window) to connect with fellow Fortians. Newsletters Read our latest newsletter and stay connected with our school life. Honour the rich history and traditions of Fort Street while embracing innovation and progress.
